rationale: CPRI gapped up ~10.5% on an earnings beat but is now consolidating in a tight range near $18.75-18.81, sitting at 78% of today's range with the last five 1-minute candles showing a mild drift lower and a high-volume bearish candle (58K shares) breaking below $18.80. The broader market is under significant pressure (SPY -1.84%, VIXY +12.28%), which creates headwinds for a long continuation, while the gap has already been largely absorbed and there is no clear momentum signal in either direction. With the stock in a choppy mid-range consolidation and macro conditions unfavorable, the risk/reward for either direction is insufficient to justify entry.
